integrity: The optimum and equality classification are proved combinatorially and independently replayed by exhaustive standard-library verification over all 65536 binary length-four code subsets. Literature comparisons distinguish the known size-five construction from the new optimality and equality classification.
scientific_limitations: The classification is finite and restricted to binary length-four \(2\)-frameproof codes; no claim is made for larger lengths, alphabets, or coalition sizes.
title: The unique extremal class of binary length-four \(2\)-frameproof codes
